data.long_meaning: Debashis is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'deba' meaning 'god' and 'shis' meaning 'master' or 'learned'. This name is given to a child who is believed to possess the qualities of a wise and intelligent god. The name Debashis carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Debashis usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
